sender_summary: Anke International is a 27-year-old Dubai-based custom display counter and refrigeration manufacturing company specializing in bespoke hospitality and food service equipment. With proven delivery for globally recognized brands like Tim Hortons and Caribou Coffee across the GCC, Anke designs and fabricates display counters, refrigeration units, and food service equipment tailored to the exact operational and brand standards of premium food & beverage groups. The team manages end-to-end project execution from consultation through custom fabrication to on-site installation.
receiver_summary: Wael Elmadany is a Senior Procurement Leader at Hashi Basha, a restaurant and food & beverage brand operating in Saudi Arabia. With a LinkedIn presence indicating significant professional tenure, he is responsible for vendor selection, equipment sourcing, supplier negotiations, and procurement strategy across Hashi Basha's operations. As a senior decision-maker, he controls purchasing budgets and timelines for major equipment categories including display counters, food service fixtures, and kitchen equipment. He operates in the KSA market and is experienced in evaluating GCC-based versus international suppliers for cost, compliance, and delivery performance.
outreach_goal: Introduce Anke International's custom commercial display counters as the preferred equipment solution for Hashi Basha's restaurant operations and secure a discovery conversation about current or upcoming procurement needs for display and food service equipment
offer: Anke International designs and manufactures custom commercial display counters and refrigeration units built specifically for restaurant and F&B brands — from service counters and food display stations to pastry showcases and refrigerated display units. With 27+ years of manufacturing experience and proven delivery for brands like Tim Hortons and Caribou Coffee in the GCC, we offer fully bespoke fabrication, competitive pricing, fast lead times, and post-installation support. For restaurant groups expanding or refreshing outlets across KSA, we deliver brand-aligned display solutions with GCC-based manufacturing proximity, shorter supply chains, and faster turnaround. Product details: https://ankeintl.com/display/
asset_name: Custom Commercial Display Counter Catalogue for Restaurant Brands (PDF)
pain_points: Restaurant procurement leaders in KSA face long lead times and high shipping costs from international display counter suppliers with no local support, Custom display equipment from overseas vendors rarely arrives on time or within spec without expensive last-minute modifications, Evaluating new fabrication vendors for quality consistency and brand alignment takes significant time that busy procurement teams rarely have
tone: Professional and peer-level — from an experienced GCC manufacturer to a seasoned procurement professional, leading with reliability, regional proximity, and total cost of ownership advantages, direct and consultative without being pushy
